title: Our House
text:
This is our house. It has three rooms and a small kitchen. In the living room, there is a big sofa and a table. The sofa is blue and very soft.

My room is upstairs. There is a bed, a desk, and a lamp next to the bed. I read books at my desk every evening. The window is big and bright.

questions.text: How many rooms does the house have?
What is next to the bed in the writer's room?
What does the writer probably enjoy doing in the evening?
How does the writer probably feel about the living room?

vocabulary.definition: a long, soft seat for two or more people
the room where food is prepared and cooked
an opening in a wall that lets in light and air
a table used for reading, writing, or studying

paragraph_translations: Burası bizim evimiz. Üç odası ve küçük bir mutfağı var. Oturma odasında büyük bir kanepe ve bir masa var. Kanepe mavi ve çok yumuşak.
Benim odam üst katta. Orada bir yatak, bir çalışma masası ve yatağın yanında bir lamba var. Her akşam çalışma masamda kitap okurum. Pencere büyük ve parlak.
